title: From Explaining to Enabling: Actionable Transparency in Algorithmic Insurance Pricing
abstract: arXiv:2610.34459v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Machine learning (ML) systems increasingly make consequential decisions about individuals, including credit, hiring, and insurance. Research on ML-driven insurance pricing has asked how the pricing mechanism itself can be made accountable. Yet it remains unclear how an individual policyholder's algorithmically determined premium should be explained to them. We argue that a useful explanation must be valid, actionable, and reliable. A valid recommendation lowers the premium according to the model. An actionable recommendation changes only characteristics the policyholder can control. A reliable recommendation has an actual outcome that is likely to meet the target, even in sparsely observed regions of the feature space where the model is uncertain. We formalize these three requirements as axioms and develop a method that turns an algorithmic premium into recommendations that meet them. The method meets the third requirement with a Conform

translated_title: 从解释到赋能：算法保险定价中的可操作性透明
translated_abstract: 机器学习（ML）系统日益对个人做出具有重大影响的决策，包括信贷、招聘和保险。关于机器学习驱动的保险定价的研究一直在探讨如何使定价机制本身具备可问责性。然而，个人投保人基于算法确定的保费应当如何向其解释，这一问题仍不清晰。我们认为，一个有用的解释必须是有效的、可操作的且可靠的。有效的建议能够依据模型降低保费；可操作的建议仅改变投保人能够控制的特征；可靠的建议其结果很可能达到目标，即使在模型不确定、特征空间观测稀疏的区域也是如此。我们将这三项要求形式化为公理，并开发了一种方法，将算法保费转化为满足这些要求的建议。该方法借助保形技术（Conform...）满足了第三项要求。
tldr: 该论文将有效、可操作、可靠三项要求形式化为公理，并开发出一种把算法保险保费转化为投保人可实际行动建议的方法，实现了从单纯解释算法决策到赋能投保人的转变。
en_tdlr: This paper formalizes validity, actionability, and reliability as axioms and develops a method that transforms algorithmically determined insurance premiums into actionable recommendations, shifting from merely explaining algorithmic decisions to enabling policyholders to act on them.
